description: This file defines a Windows Forms control called PagePreviewCanvas used for previewing PDF pages within a GDI-based implementation of PDFsharp library. It handles painting, background rendering, and resizing events to display PDF page previews.

classes.name: PagePreviewCanvas
classes.description: A Windows Forms Control that displays a PDF page preview, responsible for painting the page and background, and handling size changes.

methods.name: PagePreviewCanvas
methods.description: Constructor initializing the control with a given PagePreview object and setting style flags.

methods.name: OnPaint
methods.description: Overrides the default paint method to render the PDF page if '_showPage' is true.

methods.name: OnPaintBackground
methods.description: Overrides the background paint method to clear the background or paint it based on '_showPage' status.

methods.name: OnSizeChanged
methods.description: Handles the size change event to invalidate the control, triggering repaint.
